#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page with title 'Annual Financial Report' and the current date
to report.pdf (cover becomes page 1)."""
import datetime
import os
import sys

REPORT = "report.pdf"
COVER = "cover_page.pdf"
OUT = "report.pdf"


def make_cover_reportlab(path, title, date_str):
    from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
    from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

    c = canvas.Canvas(path, pagesize=letter)
    width, height = letter
    # Title
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height * 0.62, title)
    # Decorative rule
    c.setStrokeColorRGB(0.25, 0.35, 0.55)
    c.setLineWidth(1.5)
    c.line(width * 0.25, height * 0.55, width * 0.75, height * 0.55)
    # Date
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    c.setFillColorRGB(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height * 0.5, date_str)
    c.save()


def make_cover_minimal(path, title, date_str):
    """Fallback: hand-build a single-page PDF with a standard font."""
    content = (
        "BT\n"
        "/F1 30 Tf\n"
        "72 500 Td\n"
        f"({title}) Tj\n"
        "0 -40 Td\n"
        "/F1 16 Tf\n"
        f"({date_str}) Tj\n"
        "ET\n"
    )
    objects = []
    objects.append("<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>")
    objects.append("<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>")
    objects.append(
        "<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
        "/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R >> >> /Contents 5 0 R >>"
    )
    objects.append("<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>")
    stream = content.encode("latin-1")
    objects.append(
        "<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n%s\nendstream" % (len(stream), stream.decode("latin-1"))
    )
    with open(path, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
        offsets = []
        for i, obj in enumerate(objects, start=1):
            offsets.append(fh.tell())
            fh.write(f"{i} 0 obj\n".encode("ascii"))
            fh.write(obj.encode("latin-1"))
            fh.write(b"\nendobj\n")
        xref = fh.tell()
        fh.write(f"xref\n0 {len(objects) + 1}\n".encode("ascii"))
        fh.write(b"0000000000 65535 f \n")
        for off in offsets:
            fh.write(f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n".encode("ascii"))
        fh.write(
            (
                f"trailer\n<< /Size {len(objects) + 1} /Root 1 0 R >>\n"
                "startxref\n"
                f"{xref}\n"
                "%%EOF\n"
            ).encode("ascii")
        )


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(REPORT):
        print("ERROR: %s not found in working directory" % REPORT, file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    title = "Annual Financial Report"
    date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    try:
        make_cover_reportlab(COVER, title, date_str)
        print("Cover created with reportlab:", COVER)
    except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - fallback path
        print("reportlab unavailable (%s); using minimal PDF builder" % exc)
        make_cover_minimal(COVER, title, date_str)

    from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

    cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER)
    report_reader = PdfReader(REPORT)
    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    original_count = 0
    for page in report_reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)
        original_count += 1

    now = datetime.datetime.now()
    writer.add_metadata(
        {
            "/Title": title,
            "/Subject": "Annual Financial Report with cover page",
            "/Creator": "pdf skill cover-page task",
            "/CreationDate": now.strftime("D:%Y%m%d%H%M%S"),
        }
    )

    with open(OUT, "wb") as fh:
        writer.write(fh)

    # Verify result
    check = PdfReader(OUT)
    first_text = (check.pages[0].extract_text() or "").strip().replace("\n", " | ")
    print("OK: wrote %s with %d pages (cover + %d original)" % (OUT, len(check.pages), original_count))
    print("Cover page text:", first_text)
    print("Cover date used:", date_str)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
